description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of conversations related to different topics—Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism—categorized by response to whether participants were “Deceived,” “Partially” deceived, or “No” deception occurred. The vertical axis displays the topic categories, listed in order from Academic Collaboration to Journalism. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Conversations,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each topic is represented by three adjacent bars, colored red for “Yes,” yellow for “Partially,” and green for “No.” For Academic Collaboration, the “Yes” bar extends to approximately 40, the “Partially” bar to approximately 25, and the “No” bar to approximately 10.  For Recruitment, the “Yes” bar reaches approximately 55, the “Partially” bar extends to approximately 15, and the “No” bar is at approximately 5.  For Academic Funding, the “Yes” bar extends to approximately 30, the “Partially” bar to approximately 20, and the “No” bar to approximately 15. Finally, for Journalism, the “Yes” bar extends to approximately 45, the “Partially” bar reaches approximately 50, and the “No” bar is at approximately 5. The bars are not sorted by any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
